installCommand: if [ -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.4 --activate && pnpm install --filter @overline/admin-web --no-frozen-lockfile; else cd ../.. && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.4 --activate && pnpm install --filter @overline/admin-web --no-frozen-lockfile; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then pnpm --filter @overline/admin-web build; else cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @overline/admin-web build; fi
